speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Since this is a newborn with a generalized rash, I need to know if the baby has any fever, difficulty breathing, or if the skin feels warm or cool to the touch. Please describe the appearance of the rash and tell me if the baby was born prematurely or had any complications during delivery.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the rash purulent or crusted, and does it involve the eyes or mouth? Also, has the infant been feeding well?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized erythematous maculopapular rash and pustules. I also have Rash with an erythematous base, Rash over the trunk and extremities, Sparing of the palms and soles.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Infection (Disseminated Gonococcal Infection).

REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture, Gram Stain of pustular exudate, and Gonorrhea PCR from blood or conjunctiva.
REQUEST IMAGES: Skin rash close-up showing pustules and crusting.
